title: bug: submit_plan's rail refusal tells the planner to call propose_rail with targetScope "GLOBAL" | "EPIC" | "TASK", but checkPlanRails enforces only the global forbidden/required patterns, so an EPIC or TASK proposal can never lift a rail refusal (MCP_SERVER.md's Rail refusal note repeats the hint)
description:
Reported by architect-24611a0a from planning task-34e42a0a (msg-c788a9d9, 21:02Z on 2026-11-03). The governor re-checked it at tip ac3ea38f. The trap is live: that architect's own first submit_plan for 34e42a0a was refused because its test fixture quoted one of this board's forbiddenPatterns.

PROBLEM. A rail refusal's escape hatch offers all three scopes. EPIC and TASK proposals edit epicRails and taskRails, which the plan check never enforces. A planner who follows the hint with EPIC or TASK gets an approved proposal that changes nothing, and the plan stays refused.

EVIDENCE (at ac3ea38f):
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts:194-206 (assertPlanRails): `moe.propose_rail { proposalType: "ADD_RAIL" | "MODIFY_RAIL" | "REMOVE_RAIL", targetScope: "GLOBAL" | "EPIC" | "TASK", … }`.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/rails.ts:16-34 checks only `projectRails.forbiddenPatterns` and `projectRails.requiredPatterns`. The comment at :34 reads "Only forbiddenPatterns and global requiredPatterns are strictly enforced."
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md's submit_plan notes (about :378-380) say epicRails and taskRails are "NOT enforced in plan text". The Rail refusal bullet then says the message "goes on to name the moe.propose_rail escape hatch" without saying that only GLOBAL can lift it.

WHY BACKLOG, AFTER TWO ROWS.
- task-34e42a0a makes propose_rail able to reach the GLOBAL forbiddenPatterns and requiredPatterns at all. The new text must describe that landed path.
- task-2cc41d1a (amend_plan_step rails) may move assertPlanRails, and this refusal text with it, into util/rails.ts.
- The governor promotes this row when both are DONE.

FIX DIRECTION. The refusal names only targetScope "GLOBAL", with MODIFY_RAIL or REMOVE_RAIL of the exact forbiddenPatterns or requiredPatterns entry, in whatever shape 34e42a0a lands. The MCP_SERVER.md Rail refusal bullet says the same. Keep the refusal code and prefix (`-32003`, `Rail violation:`) unchanged.
definitionOfDone: The submit_plan rail refusal's escape-hatch text names only targetScope GLOBAL, together with the forbiddenPatterns or requiredPatterns entry shape that task-34e42a0a made reachable. A test pins that EPIC and TASK are not offered, and that the code -32003 and the 'Rail violation:' prefix are unchanged.

docs/MCP_SERVER.md's submit_plan Rail refusal note states that only a GLOBAL proposal can lift a rail refusal. The vitest run of the submit_plan and rails tests passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
reopenReason: Governor promote under the human's standing "move from backlog" (2026-11-02 21:00Z). Both prerequisites are now DONE: 34e42a0a (propose_rail GLOBAL lists) and 2cc41d1a (amend_plan_step rail check, which moved the rail check into util/rails.ts). Plan the refusal text against the landed util/rails.ts and submitPlan.ts at the tip. Placement: edit only the Rail refusal note in docs/MCP_SERVER.md; a024ac57 edits the claim_next_task and wait_for_task sections, and merge-tree lands separate sections cleanly. The human can drag this row back to BACKLOG to veto.
